escenas.prompt: Static camera with a very slow, subtle push-in toward the dark front porch at 2 a.m. In the deep shadow behind the black bench, the two small glowing eyes blink once and the dark silhouette shifts slightly. Palm fronds sway gently in a light night breeze. Porch lights stay OFF, windows stay dark. Nobody around. Nothing else moves.
Static close-up at night. The blue light ring around the video doorbell's camera pulses brighter twice, as if it just detected motion. Nothing else moves. Static camera, no zoom.

Static camera. Quiet hospital corridor during the night shift, dim calm lights. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, holds her phone; it buzzes, she stops and looks down at it, slightly curious. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.

Static camera. Quiet hospital corridor during the night shift, dim calm lights. The nurse in navy scrubs, seen three-quarters from behind, taps her phone screen twice with her thumb, then tilts her head, waiting. The phone screen is never visible. Nobody else around.

Static camera on the dark front porch at night. Suddenly the porch wall lantern and the porch ceiling light switch ON, flooding the porch with warm light and revealing that the shadow behind the black bench is a raccoon, which freezes in surprise, peeking over the bench. The sky stays dark night.

Static camera on the lit front porch at night. The startled raccoon behind the black bench drops down off the bench rail and scurries quickly to the right along the porch, behind the bench, and disappears into the dark bushes at the right edge of the frame. Porch lights stay on, the porch is now empty. Funny, natural animal movement.
